thread:
alisha: Hey team — opened a docs PR to refresh the Quickstart welcome app and the deploy snippets. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489
kevin: taking a look now. main ask: make the auth example explicit about REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_CLIENT_TOKEN.
maria: also flagging that the Node snippet uses process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN but our env var is REDWOOD_API_KEY in other guides. that will confuse users.
tyler: I can patch that in the PR. do we want to show both hosted and private deploy flows in the same quickstart?
alisha: prefer separate collapsible sections — keep the hello-world file minimal for hosted, then a short "private deploy" appendix with the VPC/KMS notes.
kevin: agree. one thing: the docker example currently exposes port 8080 but the sample app actually listens on 3000. small but will break the quicktest.
sam: i ran the container locally — confirm it's 3000. i'll add a CI smoke test step to ensure the example still starts.
doc-bot: Reminder: docs lint failed on PR 489 — md013 (line length) and link-checker found a 404 to /old-getting-started.
alisha: thanks — i'll remove the /old-getting-started link and replace with /getting-started/hello.
maria: for the auth snippet, propose this Node example: 
```
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const resp = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1-small', prompt: 'Hello world' })
});
const json = await resp.json();
console.log(json.output);
```
kevin: looks good. add a short note about storing the key in your OS keyring or Vault for tutorials that are public.
tyler: on the private deploy appendix — we should add a short command example for the customer control plane: 
```
redwoodctl deploy --mode private --vpc vpc-123 --kms key-abc --image registry.local/hello:latest
```
sam: +1. also add a troubleshooting blurb about endpoint DNS propagation and firewall rules. seen customers trip on that.
alisha: i've pushed updates to PR 489 with the variable fixes, docker port, and removed old link. leaving the CI smoke test to sam. can reviewers do a pass specifically for copy and CLI example accuracy?
maria: i'll review the prose and the python snippet next hour.
kevin: i'll re-run the link checker once updates land.
doc-bot: CI: docs-lint passed on branch, link-checker pending.
alisha: thanks all — aiming to merge by EOD if no blocker. :thumbsup:
